The remaining wildcards are narrowed to the service-managed harness resource prefixes (CloudWatch Logs log-group, log-stream, and PutResourcePolicy ARN prefixes under /aws/bedrock-agentcore/runtimes/, AgentCore workload-identity, and the AWS-owned default browser & code-interpreter prefixes) rather than a bare "*". Residual breadth: the logs:PutResourcePolicy resource prefix (/aws/bedrock-agentcore/runtimes/*) spans every AgentCore runtime log group in the account, not just this harness's group, because the service generates the runtime id only after this role is built, so the exact log-group ARN is not knowable at synth. This is accepted: the action is scoped to the AgentCore runtimes log-group prefix (never a bare "*"), and tightening to the specific group would require a custom resource to resolve the service-generated id post-create.
